notes: HB 337 (2025): for 2026 the top ordinary rate falls from 5.9% to 5.65% and the 4.7% bracket widens to $47,500 single/MFS, $71,250 HoH, $95,000 joint. 2027: 5.4% above $65,000/$97,500/$130,000.

Montana starts from federal taxable income (after the federal standard or itemized deduction, including the new federal Schedule 1-A deductions), so there is no separate Montana standard deduction or personal exemption; the federal QBI deduction must NOT be subtracted.
Net long-term capital gains are taxed at separate 3.0%/4.1% rates (not modeled).

Not modeled: $5,660 subtraction for taxpayers 65+ (2025 amount, indexed), other Schedule I additions/subtractions (e.g., state income tax add-back), Montana EITC (20% of federal from 2026), and other credits.

seDeduction.note: Inherited: federal taxable income already reflects the deductible half of SE tax.

seHealthInsurance.note: Inherited: federal taxable income already reflects the self-employed health insurance deduction.

retirementContributions.note: Inherited: SEP-IRA and solo 401(k) deductions are already reflected in federal taxable income.

qbi.note: Form 2 instructions: do not include the federal qualified business income deduction when determining federal taxable income for Montana purposes.

localIncomeTax.note: Montana cities and counties do not levy a local income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Expected Montana tax due of $500 or more after withholding and credits
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: To avoid underpayment interest, pay either 90% of the current year's tax liability or 100% of the previous year's tax liability (no 110% rule stated by the Department).
estimatedTax.form: Form IT payment voucher (or online via TransAction Portal); underpayment interest on Form EST-I

businessCosts.llcFormationFee: $35 Articles of Organization (plus $50 per series member for a series LLC)
businessCosts.annualReportFee: Annual report due April 15 every year: fee currently waived by the Secretary of State if filed by April 15 (otherwise $20 base fee); $35 if filed after April 15
